Migration guide (v1 → v2) {{ds:component/chip|label=v1 retired|variant=danger}}

v1 reached end of life on 2026-08-01 alongside the webhooks GA changelog entry. This guide covers the three breaking changes you need to handle to move a v1 integration to v2.

1. Pagination: offset → cursor

v1 used page/per_page query parameters. v2 uses an opaque cursor and next_cursor — see Rate limits & errors for the exact envelope.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=diff|language=diff|code=- GET /v1/pipelines?page=2&per_page=20 + GET /v2/pipelines?cursor=eyJvZmZzZXQiOjIwfQ}}

2. Status checks: polling → webhooks

v1 had no push notifications — you polled a pipeline's status endpoint. v2 replaces this with the Webhooks endpoint: subscribe to pipeline.completed and pipeline.failed instead of polling.

3. Error shape

v1 returned bare error strings. v2 wraps every error in an object with a stable code field. Update any error handling that matched on message text — see the error shape reference.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=v1 is retired|body_html=

v1 endpoints no longer accept requests. If you're seeing 404s on /v1/* paths, that's why — there is no grace-period fallback.

}}

Still stuck?

Common migration issues are covered in Troubleshooting / FAQ.

input.short_description: Move an existing v2 integration to the v3 API: event filtering, batch operations, and status tracking.
input.body:
Migration guide (v2 → v3) {{ds:component/chip|label=v2 withdrawn|variant=danger}}

v2 of the Events endpoint was withdrawn on 2026-08-21. This guide covers the changes you need to handle to move your integration to v3. Most changes are backward-compatible — expect a smooth upgrade.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=v2 is no longer supported|body_html=

v2 endpoints no longer accept requests. If you're seeing 404s on /v2/* paths for the Events endpoint, that's why — there is no grace-period fallback.

See v3 Events endpoint for the new API.

}}

1. Update base URL and paths

Change from /v2/ to /v3/ in your API calls.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=diff|language=diff|code=- GET /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/events + GET /v3/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/events - POST /v2/events/{id}/replay + POST /v3/events/{id}/replay}}

2. New filtering parameters

v3 adds optional until (upper bound timestamp) and status filters. These are backward-compatible — if you're not using them, your v2 code works as-is.

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=untilstringNo(New in v3) ISO-8601 upper bound on occurred_at.statusstringNo(New in v3) Filter by pending, delivered, failed, or dead-lettered.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=example-v3-filter.sh|language=bash|code=# New: filter events by status to find dead-lettered ones curl -X GET 'https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v3/pipelines/pipe_123/events?status=dead-lettered' \\\\ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY"}}

3. Batch replay (optional)

v3 introduces a new replay-batch endpoint for replaying multiple dead-lettered events in a single request. v2 required individual replay calls per event.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=batch-replay.sh|language=bash|code=# Replay all dead-lettered events from a specific time range curl -X POST 'https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v3/pipelines/pipe_123/events/replay-batch' \\\\ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \\\\ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\\\ -d '{ "since": "2026-08-20T00:00:00Z", "until": "2026-08-21T00:00:00Z" }'}}

Response shape changes

Event objects now include a status field (v3 only):

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=event-v3.json|language=json|code={ "id": "evt_8f2c1a90", "type": "order.created", "occurred_at": "2026-08-18T09:12:44Z", "status": "delivered", "payload": { "order_id": "ord_4471" } }}}

The status field is one of:

  • pending — event is being processed
  • delivered — successfully sent to destination
  • failed — delivery failed but will be retried
  • dead-lettered — delivery failed after all retries exhausted

Coming from v1?

If you're migrating from v1, you'll need to handle cursor pagination and the error shape changes. See the v1 → v2 migration guide for those details, then follow the steps above for v2 → v3.

Still stuck?

Common migration issues are covered in Troubleshooting / FAQ.
